grammarFocus: 第一、第二条件句的常见用途；建议与可能性的表达。
title: Community Clean-Up Planning: A Listening Exercise
instructions: 本材料为模拟练习，非官方雅思试题。请先听录音（或阅读录音文本），然后回答问题。问题类型包括单选、填空和判断正误/未提及。填空答案必须与原文完全一致，且不超过字数限制。所有解释均为中文，并附原文证据。
transcript:
M: Hi Lisa, thanks for coming to the community centre meeting. We need to talk about the park clean-up day.
W: Sure, Tom. I heard the council might not provide gloves this year. Is that true?
M: Well, they said they would if we asked early, but we didn't. So we have to buy our own. If we had asked in January, they would have given us gloves for free.
W: That's a shame. But we can still ask local shops for donations. If we ask the hardware store, they might give us a discount on gloves.
M: Good idea. I'll ask them tomorrow. Also, we need more volunteers. Last year only fifteen people came.
W: Fifteen? I thought it was fifty. That's a big difference.
M: No, it was fifteen. If we had more volunteers, we could finish in two hours instead of four.
W: Right. So how can we get more people? Maybe we could put up posters in the library and the supermarket.
M: Yes, and we could also post on the community Facebook group. If we post a fun video, more young people might join.
W: That sounds good. But we should also think about safety. If it rains, we need to cancel or move to the community hall.
M: Agreed. Let's set a rain date for the following Saturday. And we should provide water and snacks.
W: I can ask the bakery to donate some bread. If they agree, we can offer free sandwiches.
M: Perfect. One more thing: the council said they would collect the rubbish bags if we leave them by the gate before 3 p.m.
W: OK. So if we finish by 2:30, they will collect everything. Let's make a plan and share it with everyone.
M: I'll write it up and send it to you tonight. Thanks, Lisa.
W: No problem. See you tomorrow.

questions.prompt: What does Tom say about gloves?
options: The council will provide them for free.
They have to buy their own because they didn't ask early.
The hardware store already donated gloves.
answers: They have to buy their own because they didn't ask early.
questions.explanation: Tom说他们得自己买手套，因为没早点问。原文明确说“we have to buy our own”和“If we had asked in January, they would have given us gloves for free.”
questions.evidence: So we have to buy our own. If we had asked in January, they would have given us gloves for free.

questions.prompt: How many volunteers came last year? (Write a number.)
questions.explanation: Tom明确说去年只有15人参加。原文：“Last year only fifteen people came.” 填空答案必须与原文完全一致，原文中数字以单词形式出现，因此答案应写为“15”对应的单词“fifteen”，但题目要求写数字，故答案为“15”。
questions.evidence: Last year only fifteen people came.

questions.prompt: What does Lisa suggest to get more volunteers?
options: Put up posters in the library and supermarket.
Write a letter to the newspaper.
answers: Put up posters in the library and supermarket.
questions.explanation: Lisa建议在图书馆和超市张贴海报。原文：“Maybe we could put up posters in the library and the supermarket.”
questions.evidence: Maybe we could put up posters in the library and the supermarket.

questions.prompt: What does Lisa say they need to do if it rains?
options: Cancel the event or move to the community hall.
Continue in the park with umbrellas.
Ask the council for a tent.
Postpone the event to the following Saturday.
answers: Cancel the event or move to the community hall.
questions.explanation: Lisa说如果下雨，他们需要取消活动或搬到社区大厅。原文：“If it rains, we need to cancel or move to the community hall.” 因此正确选项是“取消活动或搬到社区大厅”。
questions.evidence: If it rains, we need to cancel or move to the community hall.

questions.prompt: What time will the council collect the rubbish bags?
questions.explanation: Tom说如果他们在下午3点前把垃圾袋放在门口，市议会就会来收。原文：“if we leave them by the gate before 3 p.m.”
questions.evidence: the council said they would collect the rubbish bags if we leave them by the gate before 3 p.m.

questions.prompt: What does Lisa offer to ask the bakery for?
questions.explanation: Lisa说可以问面包店捐一些面包。原文：“I can ask the bakery to donate some bread.”
questions.evidence: I can ask the bakery to donate some bread.

questions.prompt: Tom says he will write up the plan and send it to Lisa tonight.
questions.explanation: Tom明确说今晚会把计划写下来发给Lisa。原文：“I'll write it up and send it to you tonight.”
questions.evidence: I'll write it up and send it to you tonight.

questions.prompt: The council has promised to provide free gloves next year.
questions.explanation: 原文只提到今年没早点申请，所以没免费手套，但未提及明年市议会是否承诺提供免费手套。因此是Not Given。
questions.evidence: 未提及明年市议会承诺提供免费手套。

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the meeting?
options: To plan a park clean-up day.
To buy new gloves for the community centre.
answers: To plan a park clean-up day.
questions.explanation: 对话开头Tom说需要谈谈公园清洁日，后续都在讨论相关安排。原文：“We need to talk about the park clean-up day.”
questions.evidence: We need to talk about the park clean-up day.

questions.prompt: How long could the clean-up finish if they had more volunteers?
questions.explanation: Tom说如果有更多志愿者，他们可以在两小时内完成，而不是四小时。原文：“If we had more volunteers, we could finish in two hours instead of four.”
questions.evidence: If we had more volunteers, we could finish in two hours instead of four.

grammar.title: 第一、第二条件句的常见用途；建议与可能性的表达
grammar.explanation: 第一条件句（If + 一般现在时，will/can/may + 动词原形）用于真实可能发生的情况，常用来提出建议或警告。第二条件句（If + 一般过去时，would/could/might + 动词原形）用于假设或不太可能的情况，常用来提出建议或表达可能性。例如：If we ask the hardware store, they might give us a discount.（第一条件句，表示可能发生）If we had more volunteers, we could finish in two hours.（第二条件句，表示与现在事实相反的假设）。
grammar.example: If we ask the hardware store, they might give us a discount on gloves.

questions.prompt: If we ______ the council early, they ______ us gloves.
questions.explanation: 第一条件句表示真实可能的情况，if从句用一般现在时，主句用will + 动词原形。
questions.evidence: If we ask the hardware store, they might give us a discount on gloves.

questions.prompt: If it ______ tomorrow, we ______ the event.
questions.explanation: 第一条件句表示可能发生的天气情况，if从句用一般现在时，主句用will + 动词原形。
questions.evidence: If it rains, we need to cancel or move to the community hall.

questions.prompt: If I ______ more time, I ______ help you.
questions.explanation: 第二条件句表示与现在事实相反的假设，if从句用一般过去时，主句用would + 动词原形。
questions.evidence: If we had more volunteers, we could finish in two hours instead of four.

questions.prompt: If we ______ a fun video, more young people ______ join.
questions.explanation: 第一条件句表示可能发生的情况，if从句用一般现在时，主句用might + 动词原形表示可能性。
questions.evidence: If we post a fun video, more young people might join.

part1: Do you often take part in community activities?
What kind of community service is common in your area?
Have you ever volunteered for a clean-up or similar event?
How do you usually encourage friends to join community events?
speaking.part2: Describe a time when you helped solve a problem in your community. You should say: what the problem was, who was involved, what you did to help, and explain how you felt about the result.
part3: What are the benefits of community service for young people?
How can local governments encourage more people to volunteer?
Do you think community problems are better solved by individuals or by groups? Why?
What role does social media play in organising community events?

transfer.writing: Write an email (about 150 words) to your local community centre suggesting a way to improve a park in your neighbourhood. Use first and second conditionals to explain your ideas and their possible results.
